questions.question: In which year between 2001 and 2024 did out-of-pocket health spending experience its largest year-over-year percentage drop?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_nhe_source_of_funds.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 3', header=None)

years = [str(y).strip() for y in df.iloc[1]]
annual_change_row = None
for i in range(16, len(df)):
    if str(df.iloc[i, 0]).strip().lower() == 'out of pocket':
        annual_change_row = i
        break

year_cols = [c for c in range(len(years)) if years[c].isdigit() and int(years[c]) >= 2001]
changes = {years[c]: float(df.iloc[annual_change_row, c]) for c in year_cols}

result = min(changes, key=changes.get)

questions.question: How many of the individual annual percent change rates for private health coverage from 2015 through 2024 were at least 5 percent?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_nhe_source_of_funds.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 3', header=None)

years = [str(y).strip() for y in df.iloc[1]]
phi_change_row = None
for i in range(16, len(df)):
    if str(df.iloc[i, 0]).strip() == 'Private Health Insurance':
        phi_change_row = i
        break

target_years = [str(y) for y in range(2015, 2025)]
cols = [i for i, y in enumerate(years) if y in target_years]

count = sum(1 for c in cols if float(df.iloc[phi_change_row, c]) >= 5.0)
result = count

questions.question: What was the total expenditure on investment in health care in 2024, in billions of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_nhe_source_of_funds.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 3', header=None)
header_row_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Item'].index[0]
years = [str(y).strip().split('.')[0] for y in df.iloc[header_row_idx].values]
col_2024 = years.index('2024')

pct_header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 1].astype(str).str.contains('Average Annual Percent Change')].index[0]
amounts_df = df.iloc[header_row_idx + 1:pct_header_idx]

inv_row = amounts_df[amounts_df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Investment'].iloc[0]
result = float(inv_row[col_2024])

questions.question: What was the average annual percent change in Medicare spending from 2020 through 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_nhe_source_of_funds.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 3', header=None)
header_row_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Item'].index[0]
years = [str(y).strip().split('.')[0] for y in df.iloc[header_row_idx].values]

target_years = ['2020', '2021', '2022', '2023', '2024']
col_indices = [years.index(y) for y in target_years]

pct_header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 1].astype(str).str.contains('Average Annual Percent Change')].index[0]
pct_df = df.iloc[pct_header_idx + 1:]

medicare_row = pct_df[pct_df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Medicare'].iloc[0]
vals = [float(medicare_row[c]) for c in col_indices]
result = round(sum(vals) / len(vals), 2)

questions.question: Did consumers' out-of-pocket spending on health care drop from 2019 to 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_nhe_source_of_funds.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 3', header=None)
header_row_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Item'].index[0]
years = [str(y).strip().split('.')[0] for y in df.iloc[header_row_idx].values]

c_2019 = years.index('2019')
c_2020 = years.index('2020')

pct_header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 1].astype(str).str.contains('Average Annual Percent Change')].index[0]
amounts_df = df.iloc[header_row_idx + 1:pct_header_idx]

oop_row = amounts_df[amounts_df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'out of pocket'].iloc[0]
val_2019 = float(oop_row[c_2019])
val_2020 = float(oop_row[c_2020])

result = 'yes' if val_2020 < val_2019 else 'no'
